description: Decide a pilot round: the BUYER picks the winning pilot (the platform never auto-decides). The winner is marked WON, everyone else LOST, and the round closes; the response includes a hirePath deep-link into the existing proposal-to-hire flow for the scale-up — no money moves here. Requires open-label:write scope.

winningPilotId.description: The pilot id (from the round or comparison payload) the buyer chose to scale with.

name: opentrain_decide_pilot_round
